summary: Courtney Henderson, 19, and Gavin Caruso were stranded by a thunderstorm near the summit of South Boulder Peak, then fell ~50 feet down a rock wall; Caruso died and Henderson suffered a broken C7 vertebra, broken first rib, and head laceration; ~25 Rocky Mountain Rescue volunteers and Flight for Life responded in an overnight technical evacuation.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group (~25 rescuers), Flight for Life
notes: Month-only date per source ('June of 2020'); placeholder 2020-06-01 per month-only convention. 1 fatality (Caruso), 1 injury (Henderson). Names widely published (Backpacker Out Alive podcast). | Run 668: date corrected 2020-06-01 -> 2020-06-24 per official BCSO release (case 20-2759, 'On June 24, shortly after 7:00 p.m.'); official release URL merged.
